title: Clean Development project configuration (.clean-development.json)
description: Schema v2 (clean-development 0.8.0). Valid schema v1 files remain readable/migratable; invalid configuration grants no cleanup authority.

enabled.description: false: cleanup never lists this repo's declared directories.

heavy.description: Large builds or downloads are normal here; the session-start message warns in internal mode.

buildDirs.description: Repo-relative build output. Listed by `cleanup` for the Trash only when git-ignored; `cleanup --apply` moves them after the user's yes.

depDirs.description: Repo-relative dependency folders (node_modules, .venv, Pods). Listed by `cleanup` for the Trash only when git-ignored; `cleanup --apply` moves them after the user's yes.
